# hyperv_vm_checkpoint (Resource)

Manages Hyper-V VM checkpoints (snapshots). Supports optional restore on destroy for chaos engineering workflows.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `checkpoint_name` (String) The name of the checkpoint to create.
- `vm_name` (String) The name of the virtual machine to checkpoint.

### Optional

- `restore_on_destroy` (Boolean) If true, the VM will be restored to this checkpoint before it is deleted.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `checkpoint_id` (String) The unique ID of the checkpoint.
- `checkpoint_type` (String) The type of the checkpoint (Production, Standard, etc.).
- `creation_time` (String) The creation time of the checkpoint in ISO 8601 format.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `parent_id` (String) The ID of the parent checkpoint, if any.
